extracted.intended_audience: readers and subscribers interested in media industry news, analysis, and newsletters/podcasts
extracted.subtask_description: Homepage for a media-focused newsletter and news site that publishes frequent reporting, analysis, and a companion podcast about the media industry and information power. The page presents the publication's mission, recent articles, authors, and podcast details rather than an explicit evaluation rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hard-hitting reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a core editorial value in the site's tagline; implies vigorous, investigative, and uncompromising news gathering and presentation. No further scoring guidance provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uncompromising analysis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented alongside 'hard-hitting reporting' and 'zero spin' as a central standard; signals analysis that is direct and not diluted. The page repeats this phrasing in describing the podcast and the newsletter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zero spin
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the publication's mission statement/tagline; indicates an editorial commitment to present information without partisan or rhetorical framing. No concrete examples or metrics are given on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitive nightly briefing that cuts through the noise
rubrics_metrics.description: Status is the definitive nightly briefing that cuts through the noise to inform readers about what is really happening in the corridors of media power.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames the publication's frequency (nightly briefing) and purpose (clarify media power dynamics). This is a mission/quality claim rather than a measurable rubric; the page doesn't provide explicit criteria for how 'definitive' or 'cuts through the noise' are assessed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Podcast content standard: exclusive reporting and sharp analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: The official podcast of Status, where veteran journalists break down their exclusive reporting and deliver sharp, uncompromising analysis on how information moves and shapes society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the podcast's promised approach and content focus (exclusive reporting; veteran journalists; analysis of information flows). Notes 'New episodes drop every Friday.' No scoring details or production guidelines are given.
